Note: Real BC refuses StartSession from inside a test codeunit unless the TestRunner sets TestIsolation = Disabled. The guard is the FIRST statement of ALSession.ALStartSessionAsyncImpl (decompiled from Ncl.dll, bc281): `if (session.TestExecution != null && (!session.TestExecution.CommitTestCodeunits || !session.TestExecution.CommitTestFunctions)) throw new NavTestStartSessionNotAllowedException();`. The runner's replacement, SessionPatches.AlRunnerStartSession, has no equivalent: it runs the worker inline and returns true whatever the isolation mode is. The first test therefore reports "An error was expected inside an ASSERTERROR statement" (no error at all); the second reports the WRONG error -- with the guard missing the worker is dispatched anyway and hits #2751 (the record-carrying overload passes null to the worker's OnRun), surfacing as a bare TargetInvocationException. Both are the one missing guard; #2751 is a separate defect on the path past it. Green on all eight real-BC legs -- StefanMaron/BusinessCentral.AL.Language.Tests#149. Tracked as #2805; the fix removes this entry.
